description: Files generated from another repository by tools/sync-from-owl.mjs, each pinned by SHA-256. The commit is set by OWL_COMMIT in tools/sync-from-owl.mjs and recorded here; this file is generator output, so edit OWL_COMMIT and run --write rather than editing it. Offline checks (tests/unit/vendor.test.mjs and `node tools/sync-from-owl.mjs --verify`): each file's SHA-256, its header, and that removing the header and undoing the rewrites gives the upstream SHA-256. CI also regenerates the files from a checkout of the source at the commit and compares them (`node tools/sync-from-owl.mjs --owl <checkout> --check`).
